IEHG-TRUSS-M1.description: Inelastic Hinge Property Assignment for Truss elements (IEHG-TRUSS-M1). Assigns an existing inelastic hinge property (by name) to truss-type hinge objects; the assignment is keyed by object number and references a property defined in the Inelastic Hinge Property table.

INEL_PROP_NAME.description: Name of the inelastic hinge property to assign. Must reference an existing Inelastic Hinge Property; the name is resolved to its key at set time and an unknown name is rejected as wrong data.
